LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Neutral_Text0: Reports indicate that {0} and {1} have ended their latest confrontation. Neither domain appears willing to commit further forces for now.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Neutral_Text1: Envoys from {0} and {1} have withdrawn their most immediate threats. Their relationship has returned to an unstable neutrality.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Neutral_Text2: Military traffic between {0} and {1} has diminished. The two domains are no longer openly contesting one another.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Rivalry_Text0: {0} and {1} are contesting influence, tribute and Jaffa loyalty. Their agents have begun testing each other's borders.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Rivalry_Text1: Intercepted transmissions reveal a growing rivalry between {0} and {1}. Both domains are gathering intelligence and challenging the other's authority.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Rivalry_Text2: Claims made by {0} have been rejected by {1}. Raids and reprisals remain limited, but the dispute is hardening.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_OpenConflict_: The rivalry between {0} and {1} has become open conflict. Jaffa forces now strike each other's holdings and supply routes.
{0} and {1} have abandoned restraint. Their fleets and ground forces are now committed to direct hostilities.
Reports confirm open war between {0} and {1}. Neither domain has secured a decisive advantage.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Truce_Text0: {0} and {1} have accepted a temporary truce after costly fighting. Their forces are regrouping rather than withdrawing.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Truce_Text1: Hostilities between {0} and {1} have paused under a fragile truce. Both domains remain prepared to resume the conflict.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Truce_Text2: Envoys have imposed a ceasefire between {0} and {1}. The agreement settles nothing, but the immediate battles have stopped.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldInterDomainReport_Alliance_Text: {0} and {1} have formed a strategic alliance. Their agreement is built on mutual advantage rather than trust.
Intercepted communications confirm cooperation between {0} and {1}. The two domains are coordinating intelligence and military planning.
{0} and {1} now recognize shared interests. Their alliance may endure only while both rulers continue to profit from it.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldAlliedReinforcement_ArrivalText: As the forces of {0} press their attack, Jaffa bearing the colors of {1} emerge at the edge of the colony. The alliance between the two domains has taken a very concrete form.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldJointRaid_ArrivalText: {0} and {1} have committed forces to a coordinated assault. Jaffa bearing both domains' colors are advancing from opposite approaches.
